name: Tool

whyMatters.en: Los Angeles progressive metal band formed in 1990. Ænima and Lateralus (2001) put polymeter, long-form structures, and art-video packaging on metal radio.
whyMatters.zh: 洛杉矶 progressive metal 乐队，1990 年成立。Ænima 与 Lateralus（2001）把复合节拍、长结构与艺术录像包装送上金属电台。

lyricQuotes: I know the pieces fit / 'Cause I watched them fall away
Black then white are all I see / In my infancy

shortBio.en: Keenan / Jones / Chancellor / Carey prog-metal; Schism is the odd-meter single.
shortBio.zh: Keenan / Jones / Chancellor / Carey 的 prog-metal；Schism 是奇数拍单曲。

body.en:
Formed in 1990 in Los Angeles. From Undertow through Fear Inoculum: drop-tuned riffs, Danny Carey’s polyrhythms, Maynard Keenan’s mid-range vocal, and album gaps measured in years.

Schism (2001) is the listed track—time-signature shifts as the hook. The band occupies metal-adjacent charts with prog length and visual-art packaging rather than thrash speed.
body.zh:
1990 年于洛杉矶组建。从 Undertow 到 Fear Inoculum：降调 riff、Danny Carey 的复合节奏、Maynard Keenan 中音区人声，以及以年计的专辑间隔。

Schism（2001）是列出曲目——拍号切换即钩子。乐队占据金属邻近榜单，靠 prog 时长与视觉艺术包装，而非 thrash 速度。

note.en: Undertow breakout—drop-D riff and Keenan’s mid-range over a quiet-loud arc.
note.zh: Undertow 突破——降 D riff 与 Keenan 中音区叠 quiet-loud 弧线。

note.en: 5/8 and 7/8 meter shifts as hook—prog structure on rock radio.
note.zh: 5/8 与 7/8 拍号切换作钩子——rock 电台上的 prog 结构。

note.en: Thirteen-year gap closed—Carey tabla patterns and 10+ minute runtime return.
note.zh: 十三年间隔结束——Carey tabla 型与 10+ 分钟片长回归。

body.en:
Tool forms in LA; Opiate EP (1992) and Undertow (1993) break through with Sober. Adam Jones’s drop-D riffs and stop-start dynamics fit post-grunge radio.

Danny Carey brings jazz and tabla training to metal drums—polyrhythm inside rock song length.

Keenan’s vocal stays mid-range and restrained; lyrics stay opaque rather than confessional.
body.zh:
Tool 于 LA 组建；Opiate EP（1992）与 Undertow（1993）以 Sober 突破。Adam Jones 降 D riff 与停走动态适合后 grunge 电台。

Danny Carey 把爵士与 tabla 训练带进金属鼓——rock 曲长内的复合节奏。

Keenan 人声保持中音区克制；歌词偏 opaque，非 confessional。

body.en:
Ænima (1996) adds Stinkfist and Forty Six & 2—Chancellor’s bass tone and Jones’s visual-art packaging deepen the record identity.

Lateralus (2001) pushes Fibonacci-inspired structure; Schism’s 5/8–7/8 shifts enter MTV rotation.

Carey’s kit expands (roto toms, tabla, electronics)—prog metal with a large percussion focus.
body.zh:
Ænima（1996）加 Stinkfist 与 Forty Six & 2——Chancellor 贝斯音色与 Jones 视觉艺术包装加深唱片身份。

Lateralus（2001）推 Fibonacci 启发结构；Schism 的 5/8–7/8 切换进入 MTV 轮播。

Carey 套鼓扩展（roto tom、tabla、电子）——prog metal 侧重打击乐。

body.en:
10,000 Days (2006) takes five years; Fear Inoculum (2019) takes thirteen. Long gaps between albums become part of how the band is discussed.

Vicarious (2006) and Fear Inoculum (2019) keep odd meters and long runtimes on rock charts.

Jones directs Alex Grey artwork; packaging and video stay tied to the music releases.
body.zh:
10,000 Days（2006）隔五年；Fear Inoculum（2019）隔十三年。专辑长间隔成为乐队讨论的一部分。

Vicarious（2006）与 Fear Inoculum（2019）把奇数拍与长片长留在 rock 榜。

Jones 执导 Alex Grey 视觉；包装与 video 与音乐发行绑定。

interviewQuotes.text: The odd times aren't math homework. They're grooves that lean.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Danny Carey

interviewQuotes.text: We leave space. That silence is part of the riff.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Adam Jones

note.en: Chancellor replaces early bass; Lateralus peak form.
note.zh: Chancellor 接替早期贝斯；Lateralus 峰值形态。

note.en: 5/8–7/8 bass figure; progressive-metal radio odd-meter single.
note.zh: 5/8–7/8 贝斯型；progressive metal 电台奇数拍单曲。

note.en: Art-metal with video and polyrhythm as equal parts of the release.
note.zh: 艺术金属；影像与复节奏同为发行的组成部分。
